_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'DURATION ESTIMATING WORKSHEET' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.03.07.

f01_Parametric_Activity_and_Unit_Metric.label: Parametric Activity and Unit Metric
f01_Parametric_Activity_and_Unit_Metric.guidance: The activity name and specific unit metric rate used for parametric calculation (e.g., hours per unit).

f02_Quantity_and_Resource_Factor.label: Quantity and Resource Factor
f02_Quantity_and_Resource_Factor.guidance: Total quantity of work units and resource efficiency factor applied.

f03_Parametric_Duration_Result.label: Parametric Duration Result
f03_Parametric_Duration_Result.guidance: Calculated duration derived from the mathematical parametric formula.

f04_Historical_Reference_Activity.label: Historical Reference Activity
f04_Historical_Reference_Activity.guidance: Past project activity used as a baseline benchmark for historical comparison.

f05_Historical_Duration_and_Complexity_S.label: Historical Duration and Complexity Scaling
f05_Historical_Duration_and_Complexity_S.guidance: Duration of past activity and scaling factor applied for project scope differences.

f06_Analogous_Duration_Result.label: Analogous Duration Result
f06_Analogous_Duration_Result.guidance: Final duration outcome determined through analogous comparison.

f07_Optimistic_Most_Likely_and_Pessimist.label: Optimistic, Most Likely, and Pessimistic Durations
f07_Optimistic_Most_Likely_and_Pessimist.guidance: The recorded optimistic (tO), most likely (tM), and pessimistic (tP) estimates.

f08_Beta_Calculated_Expected_Duration_tE.label: Beta Calculated Expected Duration (tE)
f08_Beta_Calculated_Expected_Duration_tE.guidance: Calculated expected duration using the PERT beta distribution formula (tO + 4tM + tP) / 6.

f09_Standard_Deviation_and_Variance.label: Standard Deviation and Variance
f09_Standard_Deviation_and_Variance.guidance: Calculated standard deviation (tP - tO) / 6 assessing estimating risk and variance.

f10_Total_Calculated_Schedule_Buffer.label: Total Calculated Schedule Buffer
f10_Total_Calculated_Schedule_Buffer.guidance: Consolidated sum of duration contingency buffers across all estimated activities.

f11_Worksheet_Reconciliation_and_Approva.label: Worksheet Reconciliation and Approval
f11_Worksheet_Reconciliation_and_Approva.guidance: Formal review confirming no duplicate activity estimations across methods.
